title: RegimeRecord
description: One (context -> winning primitive) observation: under what conditions does a detection primitive beat the cheapest alternative. The unit of the regime ledger (design/regime_ledger.jsonl) and the eventual training row for a learned applicability/dispatch model (Level 3 — automating the tiered-dispatch policy the self-validation architecture specifies). Operationalizes the session's crystallized principle: every primitive earns its place by beating the cheapest alternative on an IDENTIFIABLE CONDITION. Append-only; the cited test/experiment is the source of truth, this row records the epistemic summary.

id.description: stable kebab id for this regime observation

corpus.description: data source (or '(hypothesized)' for an untested expected regime)

task.description: the detection task + ATT&CK technique where applicable

entity_grain.description: what the entity is: source-ip, credential, host-pair, domain-string, mixed

signal_type.description: WHERE the signal lives — the primary regime axis. cardinality=#distinct (count's turf); shape=distribution form (entropy/KL); joint=two-stream dependence (MI); temporal=ordering/timing.

population_size.description: # of cells/entities available to calibrate against — the conformal-needs-a-population axis (small=burst, conformal underpowered).

heterogeneity.description: do entities share a regime, or need per-stratum thresholds (conformal's hypothesized turf)

label_quality.description: clean=exact labels; weak=derived/noisy; synthetic=constructed ground truth; none=unlabeled/hypothesized

winner.description: the dominating primitive; 'tie' if none dominates, 'none' if nothing separates

beaten.description: the cheaper/alternative primitives the winner beat — the 'beat the marginals' record

value.description: quantitative advantage, or a short qualitative tag (e.g. 'baseline-only', 'untested')

metric.description: what the margin is measured in: AUC-delta | |disc| | recall@0FP | tie | qualitative note

evidence_tier.description: validated=real labeled data; constructive=synthetic mechanism-modelled; fair_test=self-contained fair test (real-ish, with caveats); hypothesized=expected, not tested; falsified=tested and the expected winner lost.

source.description: the test/experiment that is the source of truth for this row

notes.description: caveats and the one-line why (what condition made the winner win)
